row.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE174785: the 20 samples differ only by muscle bed (soleus/oxidative vs EDL/glycolytic) and EC-specific Atf4 genotype (WT vs Atf4 dEC); there is no sedentary vs exercised (wheel running) label, no pre/post or time factor, and GEO treatment_protocol mentions only tamoxifen. The paper's exercise comparison is the scRNA-seq dataset GSE158984 (S2.5.p1), not this one. RmEC vs WmEC is a muscle-type comparison, not an exercise effect, so analysing it would answer a different estimand than 'how exercise affects gene expression'.
row.matrix_type: estimated counts (kallisto est_counts, transcript-level ENSMUST ids)
